collaboration.title: Share with another person
collaboration.acceptHelp: Accepting gives you access to the financing and its full history. Your share is 50%. Both people can record and correct installments; the creator manages terms and access.
collaboration.paymentHelp: The detail shows the full financing amounts. Marking an installment records the full payment to the lender for both people; it does not record transfers between you.
collaboration.removeHelp: The other person will lose access. Payments and their recorded authors will remain. Your previous individual or unlinked shared setting will be restored.
collaboration.inviteHelp: The invitation appears on their dashboard and expires after 7 days. Until they accept, they have no access and their totals stay unchanged.
collaboration.inviteError: Could not invite. Check that the email belongs to another registered account and there is no pending invitation.
collaboration.actionError: Could not complete the action. Refresh and try again.
collaboration.inviteFormHelp: The invitation appears on their dashboard and expires after 7 days. Until they accept, they have no access and their totals stay unchanged. Leave the email empty to keep using unlinked sharing.
